item.title: New Apple Products to be Unveiled March 4
item.description: Apple has sent out invites to a "special Apple experience" taking place in three cities worldwide on March 4.

item.title: How Who Killed Alex Odeh? Was Edited in Adobe Premiere — Sundance Editors Interview
item.description: Winner of the US Documentary Special Jury Award for Journalistic Excellence at Sundance, Who Killed Alex Odeh? we spoke to Tyler H. Walk and Anne Alvergue.

item.title: Canon, Sony, Nikon, Fujifilm: What the Latest Financial Signals Say About the Camera Market
item.description: The latest financial signals from the big Japanese imaging firms suggest that the dedicated camera industry isn’t collapsing. However, real challenges remain, and the Big Four face very different immediate futures.

item.title: RØDE Adds Direct Bluetooth Pairing to Wireless GO Gen 3 and Wireless PRO via Free Firmware Update
item.description: RØDE has released a free firmware update that extends its Bluetooth-based Direct Connect technology from the Wireless Micro mic to the Wireless GO (Gen 3) and Wireless PRO.

item.title: What a Getty Images Photographer Has in their Winter Olympics 2026 Kitbag
item.description: Four Canon R1 bodies, 5 lenses, remote triggers, a monopod, and more. What Getty Images photographer Sean M. Haffey has in his 60 lb (27 kg) backpack at the 2026 Winter Olympics. And that's before we get to the dedicated ski bag...

item.title: Teradek CTRL.5 Firmware 2.2 Adds Sony Camera Control, Ethernet, and Web UI
item.description: Teradek has just released CTRL.5 Firmware 2.2 for its well-regarded camera control handset, adding expanded camera compatibility, improved connectivity options, and several workflow refinements aimed at on-set use.

item.title: Microsoft Updates Project Silica: 10,000 Year Memory Storage Inches Closer
item.description: Project Silica, Microsoft’s almost decade-long project to encode digital data inside glass, has just achieved a significant breakthrough in terms of the materials used.

item.title: How Jordan Cowan’s On-Ice Camera Is Transforming Olympic Figure Skating Coverage
item.description: There is a huge amount of astonishing camera work being undertaken at the 2026 Winter Olympics, but one of the absolute standouts is Jordan Cowan’s shots of figure skaters just as they’ve finished their routines.

item.title: Insta360 Link 2 Pro Review: Larger Sensor, AI Tracking, and Real Creator Potential
item.description: Insta360’s Link 2 Pro webcams add a larger sensor, smarter tracking, and real production flexibility, pushing webcams closer than ever to camera territory.

item.title: News Roundup: Apple TV & F1, Creator Studio Limits, DPA, Lucid Link, Matthews Studio Equipment, and Tamron
item.description: Tamron launches a wireless lens dongle, Foundry acquires AI orchestration platform Griptape, Apple brings F1 to IMAX, and more in this week’s production and post-tech roundup.
